title: Search Highlighting
content: Highlight matching search terms within text content. Find matches: case-insensitive search for query in text. Highlight style: bg-yellow-200 dark:bg-yellow-800 on matching text. Multiple terms: highlight each search word. Preserve case: show original text case, not search case. HTML output: wrap matches in mark or span with highlight class. Special characters: escape regex special chars in query. Performance: efficient for large text bodies. Context: show surrounding text with matches. Fuzzy matching: optional support for typos and partial matches. Clear highlights: when search clears.

variants.simple: Highlight search terms in text results.
variants.detailed: Highlight matching search terms within text content. Find matches: case-insensitive search for query in text. Highlight style: bg-yellow-200 dark:bg-yellow-800 on matching text. Multiple terms: highlight each search word. Preserve case: show original text case, not search case. HTML output: wrap matches in mark or span with highlight class. Special characters: escape regex special chars in query. Performance: efficient for large text bodies. Context: show surrounding text with matches. Fuzzy matching: optional support for typos and partial matches. Clear highlights: when search clears.
variants.advanced: Highlight matching search terms within text content for search results. Implementation: split text on matches, wrap matches in highlight element. Regex approach: create pattern with escaped query for case-insensitive matching, text.split(regex) then map with highlight on odd indices. Escape special chars: function to escape regex special characters in search query. Highlight element: mark (semantic) or span with classes, style: bg-yellow-200 text-black dark:bg-yellow-700 dark:text-white, rounded px-0.5. Multiple terms: split query by spaces, highlight each term (union into single regex or loop). React output: return array of strings and React elements. Preserve original case: use captured group in replacement to maintain original casing. Word boundary option: use word boundary matching for whole words only. Context snippets: extract ~50 chars before and after match with "..." for search result previews. Performance: for large texts, consider limiting highlight count or virtualizing results. Fuzzy matching: use fuzzy search library (fuse.js) for finding, then exact highlight of best matches. No matches: return original text unchanged. Security: sanitize output when rendering HTML content. Clear function: when query empty, return plain text without spans. Accessibility: mark element has implicit "highlighted" semantics.
